LanguageData.RT_T3485_Vehicle.label: T-34-85
LanguageData.RT_T3485_Vehicle.description:
Main Soviet medium tank of the late WW2 equipped with a 3-man turret and 85mm ZIS-S-53 cannon.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Loader x1, Bow Gunner x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 85mm ZIS-S-53 Cannon: 85x629mmR (AP / APHE / HE) - 7.62mm DTM MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
